airport.name: Aeropuerto Nacional Dr. Augusto Roberto Fuster

summary: Aeropuerto Nacional Dr. Augusto Roberto Fuster (PJC) serves as the main air gateway to Paraguay's Amambay Department in the northeast, close to the Brazilian border. The airport primarily handles domestic flights connecting the region to Asunción and supports cross-border commerce with the twin Brazilian city of Ponta Porã.
